name: mcp-architector

tools.name: set-project-architecture
tools.description: Creates or updates vertical module structure (components and dataFlow)—not horizontal facts. By default merges modules and dataFlow by name; omit dataFlow to keep existing flow. Use replaceModules or replaceDataFlow for full replace. For one module use set-module-details or set-module-data-flow. For bulk flow rebuild use rebuild-data-flow. Each new module still needs entries—use set-module-details with facts[] or set-entries after bulk structure. For APIs, domain terms, scripts use set-entry + get-slice—not this tool. If projectId is wrong, call list-projects first. Do not duplicate entry text in module descriptions.

inputs.description: What this module requires to work

outputs.description: What this module produces or generates

modules.description: List of modules in the project

providesTo.description: Modules that receive data from this module

dataTransformation.description: How data is transformed between modules

dataFlow.description: Data flow between modules; omit to preserve existing

replaceModules.description: Replace entire modules list (default false = merge by name)

replaceDataFlow.description: Replace entire dataFlow (default false = merge by module name)

tools.name: get-project-architecture
tools.description: Returns vertical structure: project description, module list, dataFlow. Use for refactoring boundaries between components. For all HTTP endpoints or domain terms use get-slice—not this tool. For one module's files and examples use get-module-details. projectId from list-projects if unsure.

tools.name: list-projects
tools.description: Lists all projects in ~/.mcp-architector with projectId, description, moduleCount, updatedAt, isCurrent. Call first when tools return empty/wrong project—the workspace path may normalize to a different id (e.g. _qs_my-app). Then pass projectId to other tools. Optional query filters by id or description.

query.description: Filter by substring in projectId or description

tools.name: set-module-details
tools.description: Creates or updates one vertical module (files, dependencies, dataFlow sync). IMPORTANT: Slices (api, domain, persistence) are built from entries, not from module text. When adding or updating a module, also add entries this module owns: pass facts[] (http-endpoint, entity, glossary, …) in this call, or call set-entry / set-entries with refs.moduleName=<module name>. Without entries, get-slice will be empty for this module. After edits call validate to verify links. Does not replace other modules. Prefer over set-project-architecture for single-module edits.

inputs.description: What the module accepts as input

outputs.description: What the module produces as output

files.description: Files belonging to this module; add matching entry kinds per Controller/Repository

facts.description: Horizontal facts for this module (APIs, entities, terms). Preferred over separate set-entry calls. Each becomes an entry with refs.moduleName set automatically. Omit only for skeleton modules.

tools.name: get-module-details
tools.description: Returns one module's full detail (files, dependencies, examples). Use when you know the module name from get-project-architecture or list-modules. If module has files but get-slice is empty, add entries with refs.moduleName=this module. For cross-cutting API/domain lists use get-slice. moduleName must match architecture exactly.

moduleName.description: Name of the module to retrieve

tools.name: list-modules
tools.description: Lists module summaries from architecture (name, description)—vertical structure only. For horizontal facts (endpoints, tables, terms) use list-slices then get-slice. After edits run validate. Use module names in set-entry refs.moduleName.

tools.name: set-module-data-flow
tools.description: Patches dataFlow for one module (dependsOn is canonical; providesTo is recomputed). Syncs module file dependencies. Prefer over set-project-architecture for single-module graph edits.

dataTransformation.description: How data is transformed between modules

tools.name: rebuild-data-flow
tools.description: Rebuilds dataFlow for all modules from module file dependencies or existing dependsOn edges. Recomputes providesTo and optionally syncs module files. Use instead of editing architecture.json directly.

tools.name: validate
tools.description: Run after set-project-architecture, set-module-details, set-entry, or set-entries. Returns a compact report (summary, stats, issues by kind)—no need to load the full project in the agent. Checks only known rules: dataFlow consistency, module↔entry links, module detail files, entry index drift, empty api/domain/persistence slices, entry slice coverage, module entry count thresholds. Fix issues[] then call validate again.

checkInverse.description: Check providesTo vs dependsOn inverse (default true)

checkEntryCoverage.description: Check modules vs entries linkage (default true)

checkStorage.description: Check module files on disk and entry index drift (default true)

checkEmptySlices.description: Warn when api/domain/persistence slices have zero entries but modules exist (default true)

checkSliceCoverage.description: Check entries match at least one built-in or custom slice (default true)

checkModuleEntryCounts.description: Check module entry count thresholds (default true)

moduleEntryMax.description: Max entries per module before module-too-many-entries (default 50)

moduleEntryMin.description: Min entries per module when count > 0; omit to disable module-too-few-entries

tools.name: validate-architecture
tools.description: Alias for validate with the same checks. Prefer validate after edits. Legacy name kept for compatibility.

checkInverse.description: Check providesTo vs dependsOn inverse (default true)

checkEntryCoverage.description: Check modules vs entries linkage (default true)

checkStorage.description: Check module files on disk and entry index drift (default true)

checkEmptySlices.description: Warn when api/domain/persistence slices have zero entries but modules exist (default true)

checkSliceCoverage.description: Check entries match at least one built-in or custom slice (default true)

checkModuleEntryCounts.description: Check module entry count thresholds (default true)

moduleEntryMax.description: Max entries per module before module-too-many-entries (default 50)

moduleEntryMin.description: Min entries per module when count > 0; omit to disable module-too-few-entries

tools.name: rebuild-entry-index
tools.description: Rebuilds entries/index.json from entry files on disk. Use when list-entries or get-slice miss entries that exist as files (index drift). Does not modify entry bodies.

tools.name: delete-module
tools.description: Deletes one module from architecture and its module detail file. Does not delete entries—remove those with delete-entry if needed. Does not delete custom slices.

moduleName.description: Name of the module to delete

tools.name: set-entry
tools.description: Entries need vertical structure: create modules via set-project-architecture / set-module-details before or when adding entries. Set refs.moduleName to an existing module name from list-modules. Run validate after edits to find entries-without-modules, entry-unlinked, or empty slices. Creates or updates one canonical project fact (entry). Use when you discovered a concrete fact while working. Do not use for module structure—use set-module-details. Do not copy module.description into summary; link via refs.moduleName only. Upsert: pass id to update, or omit id to match by kind+title or create new. Example: kind=http-endpoint, title='POST /orders', summary='Creates order', refs.moduleName='orders', refs.files=['src/OrderController.java'].

projectId.description: Project id from list-projects if workspace path may differ; defaults to MCP_PROJECT_ID

id.description: Entry uuid; omit to upsert by kind+title or create new

kind.description: Free-form type: http-endpoint, glossary, entity, flow, script, godot-scene, etc. Builtin slice list-slices shows recommended kinds per sliceId

title.description: Short unique label for search, e.g. 'POST /orders' or 'Order'

summary.description: 1-2 sentences; not a module essay—only this fact

payload.description: Kind-specific extra fields only, e.g. method/path for APIs, steps for flow

moduleName.description: Module name from list-modules. Required when project has modules. Do not paste module description here—link by name.

files.description: Workspace-relative file paths where this fact lives

entryIds.description: Related entry ids, e.g. flow steps pointing to other entries

tags.description: Optional labels for get-slice query filtering

tools.name: set-entries
tools.description: Entries need vertical structure: create modules via set-project-architecture / set-module-details before or when adding entries. Set refs.moduleName to an existing module name from list-modules. Run validate after edits to find entries-without-modules, entry-unlinked, or empty slices. Bulk upsert entries (max 200 per call). If no modules yet, call set-project-architecture first. Pass moduleName to set refs.moduleName on all entries. Prefer set-module-details with facts[] when documenting one module.

moduleName.description: Sets refs.moduleName on every entry; must exist in list-modules

tools.name: get-entry
tools.description: Returns one full entry by id. Use after list-entries or search-entries when you need payload and refs. Do not use for a full API list—use get-slice sliceId=api. Do not use for module structure—use get-module-details.

projectId.description: Project id; use list-projects if unsure

id.description: Entry id from list-entries or search-entries

tools.name: delete-entry
tools.description: Removes one entry and updates the index. Use when a fact is obsolete. Do not use to delete modules—use delete-module. Cannot delete slice definitions—use delete-slice.

tools.name: list-entries
tools.description: Returns the entry catalog (id, kind, title, tags)—no payload. Unlinked entries lack refs.moduleName; run validate after edits. For a typed horizontal view (all APIs, all domain terms) use get-slice instead. On first call, migrates legacy scripts/ folder into entries and deletes scripts/.

kind.description: Filter by exact kind, e.g. http-endpoint

tags.description: Filter entries having any of these tags

query.description: Case-insensitive substring in title, kind, or tags

tools.name: search-entries
tools.description: Compact navigation search over entries by title, summary, kind, and tags. Returns snippet, matchedIn, slices, and moduleName per hit—use get-entry for full payload. Prefer get-slice when you know the category (api, domain). Filters (moduleName, kind, tags) narrow agent context. Default limit 10.

tags.description: Filter entries having any of these tags

tools.name: list-slices
tools.description: Lists built-in and custom slice views (filters over entries—not separate stored data). Empty slice = no entries with matching kind, not a missing slice definition. Use before get-slice to pick sliceId (api, domain, persistence, …).

tools.name: get-slice
tools.description: Returns a horizontal project view: filtered entries transformed for agents. Empty slice = no entries with matching kind. Call list-slices first to pick sliceId. format=compact default; table for api slice. Use offset for pagination (limit max 200).

sliceId.description: Built-in id (api, domain, persistence, …) or custom id from list-slices

query.description: Further filter by substring in title, summary, kind, tags

format.description: compact=minimal list; detail=full entries; table=rows for API-like kinds (method/path columns)

offset.description: Skip first N items after sort (default 0)

includeModuleContext.description: If true, attach module name+description from architecture when refs.moduleName is set

tools.name: set-slice
tools.description: Saves a custom slice definition (filter only—no items). Items always live in entries. Use when built-in slices (api, domain, …) are not enough, e.g. filter kinds godot-scene + tag gameplay. Do not store duplicate entry text here. get-slice reads entries through this filter.

id.description: Custom slice id (avoid colliding with built-in: api, domain, persistence, …)

description.description: When an agent should use this slice

kinds.description: Include entries with any of these kind values

tags.description: Include entries having any of these tags

tools.name: delete-slice
tools.description: Deletes a custom slice definition only. Built-in slices (api, domain, …) cannot be deleted. Does not delete entries—use delete-entry.
